description: Start dictation mode. Speak naturally — text accumulates across pauses and the combined result is written when dictation ends. Runs until stop_dictation is called or silence timeout. Docs: https://useminutes.app/docs/mcp/tools#tool-start_dictation

language.description: Transcription language code (e.g. 'en', 'ur', 'es', 'zh'). Overrides config.toml setting.

name: start_dictation
